title: The old bed
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Monday. Ten months in. The pup gets into the old bed for the first time. Not remarked. Wood at the table, drawing; the strip draws his hand stopping for one panel and then going on.

panels.composition: The garage. The braided bed under the table — the old one, unused since December. BARNABY II circling it.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog circling a braided dog bed beneath a drafting table, no words

panels.composition: In. The pup lying down in it. Turning once. Settling.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog lying down in a braided bed and settling, no words

panels.composition: WOOD's hand at the table above. The brush stopped mid-stroke. One panel.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a man's hand holding a brush stopped mid-stroke above a page, no words
image.notes: The only remark: the brush stops for one panel.

panels.composition: The hand going on. The stroke finished. The pup asleep in the bed below. The garage as it was in 2013, with a different dog in the same place.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man drawing at a table while a small three-legged dog sleeps in a braided bed beneath it, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Wordless. The old bed, used. The brush stops once.
